enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to stay cool through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull sheet over body. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed to medium. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off sheet. Pull sheet back. Turn fan speed to high. Turn to back. Place arm over eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust fan direction. Pull sheet up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Cup hands. Splash water on face. Pick up soap. Apply soap. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a quick breakfast of toast and tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Take out plate. Place bread on plate. Insert bread into toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch. Take out mug and tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Pour water into mug. Remove tea bag. Add milk. Remove toast. Spread butter. Sit. Eat toast. Drink tea. Rinse plate and mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing a bag and water bottle for the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Open closet. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on work clothes. Pick up water bottle. Fill water bottle in kitchen. Place water bottle in bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone and keys.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag on lap. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office. Open office door. Walk to desk. Put down bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community nonprofit: checking emails, preparing program materials and running morning sessions with participants
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Check emails. Reply to emails. Open program documents. Print documents. Walk to printer. Pick up documents. Walk back. Organize materials. Walk to meeting room. Set up chairs and projector. Greet participants. Start session. Speak. Distribute materials. Answer questions. End session. Walk back to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating in a cool shaded spot nearby
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nearby park. Find shaded bench. Sit down. Open bag. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Open water bottle. Drink water. Eat sandwich. Eat apple. Close lunch box. Put trash in bag. Stand up. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program logistics, meetings and admin tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Check emails. Open spreadsheet. Update logistics. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Attend meeting. Take notes. Walk to copier. Make copies. Walk back. File documents. Organize files.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Place on counter. Take out pan. Turn on stove. Pour oil. Cut vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add chicken. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Place food on plate. Sit. Eat dinner. Drink water. Rinse plate. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting in the bedroom with the fan on and reading, avoiding air-conditioner use during the peak grid hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Pick up book. Lie down on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn to back. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and freshening up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature to cool. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the couch with the air conditioner on now that peak hours have passed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Walk to kitchen. Take out snack. Walk back. Sit. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and sleeping, with the fan on for cooling
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Place arm over eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust fan direction. Pull blanket up. Sleep.
